description: Desktop only. Saves a complete stdraft document as the session's cloud draft; patches are not accepted. base_package_id must be the draft's current version, or empty when the draft has not been created yet - the first successful save creates the draft. The document is validated first: if validation fails, nothing is saved and error_code is STDRAFT_INVALID. If base_package_id is no longer the current version, nothing is saved and error_code is STDRAFT_VERSION_CONFLICT. On success it returns the version it just created as server_package_id, and usually also reads the saved draft back from the cloud and returns it as stdraft_json: when stdraft_json is present, use it together with server_package_id as the baseline for the next round instead of calling get_stdraft_snapshot. The document read back is re-derived from the cloud draft the same way get_stdraft_snapshot does it, so it can differ from the one just pushed. stdraft_json is absent when the read-back did not produce a document matching server_package_id, which does not affect the save; call get_stdraft_snapshot to obtain the baseline in that case. Success also returns two links to the browser editor for this draft - web_editor_url for the full web editor in the user's own browser, labeled with the server-localized web_editor_text, and embed_editor_url for Codex's in-app browser to open or reuse this session's editor tab - and clears the agent's editing mark on the draft.
